تستخلبي (form X)
# تَسْتَخْلِبِي (tastaḵlibī) /tas.tax.li.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# تُسْتَخْلَبِي (tustaḵlabī) /tus.tax.la.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
